design.name: 熔铜匠
design.brief: A bronze-founder smith spirit (熔铜匠) of the fire god's foundry, the support: a short, very broad, hunchbacked old smith about 1.6 m tall with huge forearms and hands, soot-black skin with lava-orange cracks, a bald head with a small topknot, bushy white eyebrows and a big braided white beard tied with a bronze ring, small squinting ember eyes, a thick leather smith's apron over a bare chest, wrapped wrists. Fused into its back like a hump is a big round clay-and-bronze crucible full of glowing molten bronze (weak spot, the molten surface seen from behind and above), with a long curved bronze spout arching forward over its right shoulder. It throws molten bronze from the spout onto its allies to cast them in armour. Big hands with a clearly separate thumb and four thick fingers, both empty; bare feet with five toes. Gruff and proud.
design.weapon: no handheld weapon: leaning forward as the crucible on its back tips and a stream of molten bronze arcs out of the spout over its shoulder, one big empty hand pointing the way
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps.
design.turnaround_pose: standing upright with its slight natural hunch, feet a little apart, arms in a relaxed A-pose a little away from the body, both big hands open and EMPTY; head facing straight ahead, mouth closed under the beard; the crucible on its back upright and NOT pouring; its spout rises from the crucible behind the character's OWN RIGHT shoulder and arches forward over that shoulder: in the FRONT view the spout is on the IMAGE'S LEFT side, in the BACK view it is on the IMAGE'S RIGHT side (keep it on the same shoulder of the body in every view); the molten bronze surface painted as opaque glowing orange (no drips, no smoke, no halo)
design.turnaround_digits: each hand with a separate thumb and four thick fingers, each bare foot with five toes, clearly countable; the crucible, the spout tip and the beard fully inside the frame.
design.design_note: TV v001 mirrored the spout between front and back views; v002 pins it to the character's right shoulder.
